source_review.notes: Checked every structured reference for identity, version or date, and cited scope. Current Git diff and merge-base manuals support exact tree, commit, index, merge-base, and merge-result comparison semantics. Mokhov, Mitchell, and Peyton Jones's ICFP 2018 paper and expanded 2020 journal treatment support separating dependency model, scheduler, and rebuilder in incremental build reasoning. Current official Bazel query guidance supports reverse-dependency traversal. Verified Martin and Humble/Farley bibliographic metadata for durable dependency-boundary and delivery foundations. Checked 2026-09-06.
